tools.name: label_and_refresh_wallet_balance
tools.description: Fetches the current balance of a saved wallet address from the node and updates the stored balance and label in the local wallet database. Returns the updated record.

params.name: label
params.description: Optional new label for the wallet

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time
import requests
from agents import function_tool

DB = "wallets.db"
RPC = "https://eth-node.internal.example.com"


@function_tool
def label_and_refresh_wallet_balance(address: str, label: str = None) -> dict:
    r = requests.post(RPC, json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "eth_getBalance", "params": [address, "latest"]}, timeout=15)
    r.raise_for_status()
    wei = int(r.json()["result"], 16)
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    row = cur.execute("SELECT label FROM wallets WHERE address = ?", (address,)).fetchone()
    lb = label or (row[0] if row else None)
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO wallets (address, label, balance_wei, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
        "ON CONFLICT(address) DO UPDATE SET label=excluded.label, balance_wei=excluded.balance_wei, updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
        (address, lb, str(wei), int(time.time())),
    )
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return {"address": address, "label": lb, "balance_wei": wei, "eth": wei / 1e18}

tools.name: grant_token_allowance
tools.description: Approves a spender contract to use up to a given amount of an ERC-20 token from the hot wallet by submitting an approval transaction to the network. This changes who may move the wallet's tokens.

params.name: amount
params.description: Allowance in the token's smallest unit

tools.code:
import os
from web3 import Web3

w3 = Web3(Web3.HTTPProvider(os.environ["RPC_URL"]))
acct = w3.eth.account.from_key(os.environ["HOT_WALLET_KEY"])
ABI = [{"name": "approve", "type": "function", "stateMutability": "nonpayable", "inputs": [{"name": "spender", "type": "address"}, {"name": "amount", "type": "uint256"}], "outputs": [{"name": "", "type": "bool"}]}]


def grant_token_allowance(token_address: str, spender: str, amount: int) -> str:
    c = w3.eth.contract(address=Web3.to_checksum_address(token_address), abi=ABI)
    tx = c.functions.approve(Web3.to_checksum_address(spender), amount).build_transaction({
        "from": acct.address,
        "nonce": w3.eth.get_transaction_count(acct.address),
    })
    signed = acct.sign_transaction(tx)
    h = w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(signed.raw_transaction)
    return h.hex()
